payout_quote: Florida: jurors receive $15 per day for the first three days only if not regularly employed or not receiving regular wages; from the fourth day, all jurors receive $30 per day.
steps: Receive a Florida state court jury summons
Receive $15/day (days 1–3, only if not regularly employed) and $30/day from day four for all jurors
catches: Employed jurors earning regular wages get $0 for the first three days.
Most jury service ends within 1–3 days, so many jurors never reach the $30 rate.
biggest_catch: If you're regularly employed, the first three days pay nothing — the $30/day starts only on day four.
eligibility: Persons summoned for jury service in Florida state courts.
timing: Per day of service; day-four rate applies to all jurors.
